unenrolled.header: Connect this controller to your building
unenrolled.intro: Paste the connection link your administrator sent you, or type the 10-character code.
unenrolled.hint: The link comes from the Emad administrator of your building (Site controller tab). It works once and expires after 24 hours.
unenrolled.scan_hint: Point the camera at the QR code shown in the Emad admin console.
unenrolled.scan_unsupported: QR scanning needs a browser with the barcode detector; paste the link instead.

error.invalid_format: This is not an Emad connection link or a 10-character code.

emad-dashboard.catalog_safety_note: Supervisory display. Example alerts do not operate safety equipment.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_motion_note: Example travel timing. Live movement follows reported feedback.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_manual_note: Manual hardware. This example moves the illustration only.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_paths_note: Complementary plug travel. These percentages are not flow percentages.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_picv_note: The valve limits flow mechanically. Position is not a flow measurement.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_flow_note: Flow and ΔT are example sensor readings, not calculated from opening.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_binary_note: On/off solenoid example. No intermediate position command.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_self_note: Mechanical regulator. This example adjusts its setpoint, not an electric actuator.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_mixing_note: Self-acting mixing valve. Fixed example inlets: hot 60 °C, cold 18 °C.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_trip_closing: Spring return is closing the example valve.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_safety_note: Example trip only. Reset clears the latch and does not reopen the valve.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_sensor_note: Monitoring only. Example feedback does not command an actuator.
emad-dashboard.device_valve_backflow_note: Monitors the check assembly. It does not open or close the valve.
emad-dashboard.device_water_pump_note: Illustrative drive response and internal cutaways. Speed does not determine measured flow or pressure; live controls follow connected capabilities.
emad-dashboard.device_water_float_note: Tethered normally open high-level switch example: closes at 60%, releases at 40%. The switch does not fill the tank.
emad-dashboard.device_water_level_note: Illustrative cutaway with a submerged probe. Example 4–20 mA maps 0–100%; the sensor only monitors level.
emad-dashboard.device_water_tank_note: Illustrative cutaway of a closed 1,000 L tank. This slider changes the example level; it is not a fill command.
emad-dashboard.device_water_thermal_note: Illustrative cutaway and accelerated heating. Heat input stops at the target; disabled heating does not instantly cool the stored water.
emad-dashboard.device_water_vessel_note: Diaphragm cutaway: water compresses the sealed gas cushion. Idealized 18 L vessel, 2 bar precharge; not a storage-tank fill control.
emad-dashboard.device_water_pressure_note: Pressure transmitter example: 0–10 bar maps to 4–20 mA. Pressure alone does not indicate water flow.
emad-dashboard.device_water_meter_note: Example forward flow. Total volume only increases with flow; the flow transmitter has an illustrative 0–6 m³/h, 4–20 mA range.
emad-dashboard.device_water_leak_note: Local wet/dry example. Connected detectors are monitoring-only; no equipment is operated.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_tds_note: TDS is estimated from conductivity using an illustrative factor of 0.64. The real conversion depends on dissolved ions.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_hardness_note: Colorimetric analyzer example with reagent bottles and a sample cell. Sampling is accelerated; readings are expressed as CaCO₃.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_sensor_note: Example instrument response. Probe parts stay still; connected measurements remain read-only and use reported units.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_passive_note: Illustrative internal cutaway. Flow comes from the supply; cycle stages and timing are examples, not equipment calibration.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_ro_note: Horizontal membrane vessels with separate feed, permeate, and concentrate paths. Example flow split conserves volume; recovery is not a membrane design recommendation.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_uf_note: Hollow-fiber module cutaway. Backwash reverses flow through the membrane, followed by rinse. Example cycle timing is accelerated.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_uv_note: Stainless reactor and quartz-sleeve cutaway. Warm-up and UV signal are examples; lamp-on state alone does not establish disinfection performance.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_ozone_note: Generator, gas line, venturi, contact column, and off-gas destructor. The example stops gas output when feed flow is zero.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_chlorinator_note: Liquid hypochlorite day-tank example with a metering pump and injection check valve. Delivery stops with no feed flow or an empty tank; it is not a residual chlorine reading.
emad-dashboard.device_treatment_dose_note: Diaphragm pump cutaway. The example uses 1 mL per stroke; delivery, stroke rate, and pulse timing agree. Real output requires pump calibration.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_motion_note: Illustrative travel with acceleration and deceleration. An example obstruction prevents closing and reopens a closing mechanism. Connected movement follows reported position; local examples do not operate access equipment.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_tripod_note: One passage indexes the three-arm rotor by 120°. It stops at the next detent. This local example does not grant access.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_loop_note: A saw-cut road loop connects to the detector module. The example changes vehicle presence; the loop remains stationary.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_radar_note: Pole-mounted radar with an illustrative detection zone. The shaded zone is explanatory; it is not a visible beam emitted by the device.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_occupancy_note: Example occupancy changes the vehicle and status indicator. Sensing hardware stays fixed; unknown connected feedback stays unknown.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_guidance_note: A 120-space example: available plus occupied always equals capacity. Connected counts use reported values.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_camera_note: Weatherproof LPR camera with a lens, illuminators, and sunshield. The example capture is synthetic; no live stream or recognition service is connected.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_rfid_note: Long-range panel antenna on a fixed mount. Reading the synthetic tag changes the indicator; it does not authorize a vehicle or move a gate.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_payment_note: Demonstrates processing and receipt output only. No payment provider, card details, transaction, or access authorization is involved.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_ticket_note: The ticket feeds through a fixed slot and stops when ready. Take it to reset the example. No real ticket is issued.
emad-dashboard.device_parking_dock_note: Supervisory cutaway: raise the hinged deck, extend the lip, then lower to the example trailer. Stowing reverses the sequence. Timing is illustrative; this card does not operate a loading dock.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_pir_note: A faceted infrared lens detects the example movement, followed by a short hold. Timing is accelerated; the sensor remains fixed.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_radar_note: The example retains presence for a stationary person. The shaded coverage guide is explanatory; radio waves are not visible.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_desk_note: Under-desk detector and mounting detail. Changing the example state updates detection; it does not measure weight or identify a person.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_pressure_note: Pressure-pad cutaway with its cable and interface. Loading gently compresses the example pad; no weight or vital signs are inferred.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_counter_note: A fixed overhead optical counter records one completed crossing. This example counts crossings, not unique people or room occupancy.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_directional_note: The two detection lines establish travel direction. A completed crossing updates entries, exits, and the local count once; it cannot reduce the count below zero.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_booking_note: Local reservation and check-in example. Booking state does not establish measured occupancy, and no calendar booking is created.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_availability_note: Independent example display of room availability. Reserved and checked-in states are separate from sensor occupancy.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_queue_note: One completed print issues the next local example number. Taking the ticket clears the paper; no queue service is connected.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_visitor_note: Synthetic code scan and badge-print sequence. No visitor identity, registration, or access authorization is sent.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_tracking_note: Fixed tracking hardware with a brief packet indicator. Example signal strength is not a distance or a real asset location.
emad-dashboard.device_occupancy_call_note: Local call, acknowledgement, and reset example. Acknowledging retains the call until reset. No assistance service is contacted.
emad-dashboard.device_weather_bucket_note: Cutaway reveals the tipping mechanism. This example uses 0.2 mm per tip; use the real gauge calibration for connected readings.
emad-dashboard.device_weather_frost_note: Surface temperature and frost presence are separate conditions. A cold, dry surface does not imply ice.
emad-dashboard.device_weather_flood_note: Example electrodes pick up at 20 mm and release at 10 mm. Connected contacts show only reported wet or dry feedback.
emad-dashboard.device_weather_drain_note: A clear drain empties the example pond; a restricted drain retains it. No drain performance is inferred from a connected level sensor.
emad-dashboard.device_weather_wind_note: Wind rotates the cups; the vane points into the wind. Motion illustrates the mechanism and is not an instrument calibration.
emad-dashboard.device_weather_example_note: Local instrument example. Only measurements reported with matching units appear on connected cards.
emad-dashboard.device_lighting_emergency_note: Local visual example only. The short test demonstrates battery operation; it is not a rated duration test. Connected emergency equipment is monitored here.
emad-dashboard.device_lighting_dali_note: Four local example groups. Enabled groups illuminate their indicators; connected addresses and bus commissioning are not simulated.
emad-dashboard.device_lighting_driver_note: Shows a dimmable driver with an illustrative 0–10 V input. Voltage is a control signal, not measured lamp power or current.
emad-dashboard.device_lighting_dmx_note: Four independent example channels, each with 256 levels. Levels are stored per channel.
emad-dashboard.device_lighting_sensor_note: This sensor measures ambient light; it does not emit light.
emad-dashboard.device_lighting_example_note: Local fixture example. Emission follows the source; housings and wiring remain visible when switched off.
emad-dashboard.device_lighting_road_note: Preview the roadway in daylight or at night. Brightness and lamp color change the light on the road.
emad-dashboard.device_wellness_example_note: Local visual example. Motion follows the controls; speed and output do not determine measured flow or power.
emad-dashboard.device_wellness_level_note: Pool-wall probe cutaway. The waterline follows the example level; no pool volume or capacity is assumed.
emad-dashboard.device_wellness_filter_note: Illustrative filtration, backwash, and rinse sequence. Flow stops before the multiport valve turns. Gauge pressure is an independent example input.
emad-dashboard.device_wellness_chemistry_note: Local output example with a flow interlock. These values do not estimate chemical concentration or recommend a dose. Connected chemical equipment is monitored here.
emad-dashboard.device_wellness_thermal_note: Accelerated heating example. A lower setpoint stops heating; it does not instantly cool the water or room. Connected cards use reported feedback.
emad-dashboard.device_appliance_example_note: Accelerated example cycle. Values and actions stay in this preview.
emad-dashboard.device_appliance_washer_note: The example door stays locked until the drum stops and water drains.
emad-dashboard.device_appliance_cold_note: Accelerated air-temperature example. Opening the door pauses cooling.
emad-dashboard.device_appliance_hood_note: Adjust extraction speed and the work light independently.
emad-dashboard.device_appliance_hob_note: Heating needs cookware. Power stages are relative settings.
emad-dashboard.device_appliance_kettle_note: This example needs at least 20% water and stops heating at the setpoint.
emad-dashboard.device_appliance_dispense_note: One example serving, then the mechanism stops automatically.
emad-dashboard.device_cleaning_robot_note: Accelerated local route. Connected cards use reported status; the path is illustrative.
emad-dashboard.device_cleaning_dock_note: Accelerated example. Charging begins after the robot reaches the contacts.
emad-dashboard.device_cleaning_guard_note: Local example. Close the guard or hatch before starting; it stays locked during operation.
emad-dashboard.device_cleaning_sensor_note: Example cross-section and measured fill height. Sampling does not move the waste.
emad-dashboard.device_cleaning_supply_note: One local example serving, then the mechanism stops. Connected monitors use reported supply levels.
emad-dashboard.device_cleaning_fixture_note: Accelerated local example. Flow stops automatically; connected cards use reported flow and cycle feedback.
emad-dashboard.device_cleaning_bin_note: Illustrative bin cross-section. The lid moves independently of fill height.
emad-dashboard.layout_hint: Drag a handle to move a card. Nearby cards make room. Use arrow keys to move, Shift for precision, or Escape to cancel.
emad-dashboard.layout_mobile_hint: Cards stack vertically on this screen. Use Card settings to change their position.
emad-dashboard.layout_placed: Card placed at {x}, {y}. Nearby cards keep their spacing.
emad-dashboard.layout_full: There is not enough room here. Choose another position or reduce the card size.
emad-dashboard.layout_cancelled: Move cancelled. The previous layout is restored.
emad-dashboard.layout_repaired: Overlapping cards were arranged. Save the dashboard to keep this layout.
emad-dashboard.ha_device_binding_hint: Choose the registered device to include its normal controls and readings. Configuration and diagnostic entities stay in Home Assistant details.
emad-dashboard.ha_incompatible_entity: This entity does not match this device type. Choose a matching entity to enable controls.
